title: Plan: strict cold no-source prefill limit down-sweep
purpose: After prefill_limit=3192 regressed by eliminating dynamic admission space, test whether lower prefill limits improve the accepted route by reserving more slots for runtime admission while reducing TTFT.

rejected_3192.reason: Full prefill increased misses and TTFT, likely because runtime admission had no spare slots.

candidate_limits.hypothesis: May reduce TTFT and allow more dynamic admission; could help if accepted misses are dominated by runtime entries absent from the static top3000 profile.
More aggressive admission capacity. Run only if 2800 does not clearly fail or if time permits; higher risk of losing too many high-frequency prefilled entries.

accepted_if: France answer remains semantic and coherent
full reproduction metadata is recorded and pushed

notes: This is a no-source parameter probe; it cannot reach 10 tok/s alone.
It is still useful because a compliant current-route improvement must be promoted immediately and becomes the new baseline for larger work.
